<entry id="M00028">
<head-word>מְאִיס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="M00049">מְאַס</xref>) 
<italic>to be sticky, soiled; to be repulsive</italic> (cmp. זהם).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. XXXVIII, 6 (Ms. איתימסיו, v. מְסִי).—B. Kam. 18
<sup>a</sup> דמ' בלישא (not דמאוס), v. ווּס.—Part. מָאִיס. Targ. Ps. LVIII, 9 (ed. Wil. מָאַס, read מָאִס).—Keth. 63
<sup>b</sup> מ' עלי he is repulsive to me. Yoma 63
<sup>b</sup> משום דמ' because it is offensive (on account of blemishes).—Ber. 50
<sup>b</sup> מידי דלא מ' Ms. M. (ed. מִמְּאִיס) something which is not sticky (the handling of which does not create aversion); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מְאִיסִין, מְאִיסֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 13 (opp. מנטלין).—Yeb. 100
<sup>a</sup> משום דמ' because they (the uncircumcised and the unclean) are rejected on account of their physical condition; a. e.—Lam. R. to III, 45 (transl. סחי ומאוס, ib.) מְאִסַיָּיא פְּסִילַיָּיא loathsome, outcasts, v. פְּסִילָא.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִמְּאִיס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to become repulsive, to decay</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 50
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra. Pes. 28
<sup>a</sup> חמץ דמִמְּאִיס Ms. M. 1 (Ms. M. 2 דמאיס; ed. דמִמִּיס) leavened matter which decays in course of time; ib. ע"א דלא ממאיס Ms. M. 1 (Ms. M. 2 מאיסה; ed. מִמִּיסָה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) an idolatrous object which is not subject to decay.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M00029">

<sense>
<definition>
<italic>food; meal; meal-time</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 10
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 12
<sup>b</sup> מַאֲכַל לודים, v. לוּדִים. Ber. 40
<sup>a</sup> אסור … עד שיתן מ' לבהמתו a person is forbidden to eat before giving food to his animal. Taan. 20
<sup>a</sup> מ' אדם food fit for human beings; a. fr.—[Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78
<sup>c</sup> אפי' מ' אפי' כסות, read: אפי' מובל אפי' כפות, v. יָבַל.]—
<plural-form>Pl. מַאֲכָלוֹת</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 20 שתהא אוכל מ' כאדם that thou shouldst eat food like human beings; (Tosef. Sot. IV, 17 מעדנים, Var. מאכל אדם).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00044">
<head-word>מַאֲמָר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> אָמַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>command, order.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. V, 1 והלא במ' אחד וכ' could not the universe have been created by one divine command?—Meg. 21
<sup>b</sup>; R. Hash. 32
<sup>a</sup> בראשית נמי מ' הוא the first verse of Genesis is also to be considered a command. Gen. R. s. 4 המים … תלוים במ' the upper waters are suspended (in the air) by a divine ordainment; Taan. 10
<sup>a</sup>.—Sabb. 63
<sup>a</sup> העושה מצוה כמַאֲמָרָהּ who executes a divine command as it has been ordained; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. מַאֲמָרוֹת</plural-form>. Ab. l. c. בעשרה מ' וכ' the world was created by ten divine orders (counting nine ויאמר in Gen. ch. I, and the first verse, v. supra).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>word</italic>, esp. 
<italic>maămar, the Yabam’s betrothal</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="J00058">יָבָם</xref>) by word of mouth, contrad. to the consummation of marriage (בִּיאָה).</definition>
<notes> Yeb. II, 1 עשה בה מ' if he betrothed her to himself; Y. ib. 3
<sup>c</sup> איזו היא מ' וכ' what is a 
<italic>maămar</italic> with regard to a 
<italic>Y’bamah</italic>? Saying, ‘Be betrothed unto me’, while handing to her money or money’s worth. Ib. מ' גומר betrothal consummates the 
<italic>yabam’s</italic> marriage (carrying with it all the legal consequences of his marriage), v. גָּמַר; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00045">

<entry id="M00046">
<head-word>מָאַן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pi.</italic> מֵיאֵן, מֵאֵן 
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key> v. 
<xref rid="A01360">אֵין</xref>) 
<italic>to deny, refuse</italic>, esp. </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (of a woman betrothed in childhood, on arriving at majority) 
<italic>to protest against, to annul one’s marriage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. XIII, 1 אין מְמָאֲנִין אלא ארוסות only betrothed (not married) women may have their obligation cancelled. Ib. מְמָאֶנֶת והיא קטנה וכ' she may protest (have her marriage cancelled) even while yet a minor, and even four or five times in succession. Ib. 2 איזו … שצריכה למָאֵן what minor is bound to make declaration (before leaving her husband)?—Ib. 4 הממאנת באיש וכ' if a woman refuses her husband by declaration, he is permitted to marry her kindred (who otherwise would be forbidden to him); a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to advise a protest.</italic></definition>
<notes> Eduy. VI, 1 שמְמָאֲנִים וכ' that the court eventually advises women married as minors to protest; Nidd. 8
<sup>a</sup>; Ber. 27
<sup>a</sup>.—V. מִיאוּן.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00047">
<head-word>מַאן</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. מָא) 
<italic>who?, what?, which?;</italic> (relat.) 
<italic>who, which</italic>.</definition>
<notes> [Targ. מַן.] Sabb. 57
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. מ' דכר וכ', v. דְּכַר I. Yeb. 107
<sup>b</sup> מ' לא הודו לו who is meant by ‘they did not agree with him’? Ib., a. fr. מ' תנא who is the authority for the law just quoted?, i.e. whose opinion is here represented?—Ḥull. 50
<sup>a</sup> אמר מ' דהו somebody said; Bets. 27
<sup>a</sup>; M. Kat. 22
<sup>a</sup>; (Nidd. 48
<sup>a</sup> ר' זירא). Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> פוק חזי מ' בעי וכ' go out and see who it is that wants thee outside (an intimation of a teacher’s displeasure); Gen. R. s. 33 (some ed. מַן). Ber. 30
<sup>b</sup>; Ḥull. 7
<sup>a</sup> חזי מ' גברא וכ' see how great a man gives testimony about him. Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53
<sup>b</sup> bot. מ' דאמר וכ' according to him who says &c.; a. v. fr.—V. מַן.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00048">
<head-word>מָאן</head-word>
<head-word>מַאן</head-word>
<head-word>מָאנָא</head-word>
<head-word>מָן</head-word>
<head-word>מָנָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="M00047">preced.</xref>) [
<italic>thing</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>vessel, utensil</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. II, 9. Targ. Lev. XI, 33; a. fr. (interch. with מָן, מַן).—B. Kam. 17
<sup>b</sup> מ' תבירא תבר it was a broken vessel he broke. Ib. בתר תבר מ' אזלינן we judge by the final cause by which the vessel was broken; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. מָאנִין, מָאנַיָּא, מָאנֵי, מָנ'</plural-form>. Targ. Ex. XI, 2; a. fr.—Sabb. 105
<sup>b</sup> תבר מ' תבירי broke broken vessels (pretending to be angry); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. כֶּלִי) 
<italic>garment, dress</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 113
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup> קרי למָאנֵיה וכ' called his dress (garments) &c., v. כָּבֵד I; B. Kam. 91
<sup>b</sup> למאני (corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).—B. Mets. 47
<sup>a</sup> במ' דכשר למקני ביה (symbolical possession has been given) by means of a garment fit for the purpose; a. fr.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> top; Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> top מָאנוֹי, v. בְּזַע; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (= h. קַנְקַן) [
<italic>handle</italic>,] 
<italic>coulter of the plough</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 80
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="M00049">
<head-word>מָאַס</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. מסס)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to melt, faint</italic>,] (with ב) 
<italic>to be tired of, loathe;</italic> (with accus.) 
<italic>to cast away, reject</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> אין הקב"ה מוֹאֵס בתפלתו וכ' the Lord never tires of the prayer of assemblies. Sifra B’ḥuck. ch. III, Par. 2 מואס באחרים despises others (for being his betters); (ib. מואס אחרים, corr. acc.). Tanḥ. Mishp. 11 כבר מָאֲסָן וכ' their god has rejected them; Ex. R. s. 31. Ib. אמת שמָאַסְתָּ וכ' is it true that thou hast rejected thy son?; a. fr.—Part. pass. מָאוּס, f. מְאוּסָה; pl. מְאוּסִים, מְאוּסִין; מְאוּסוֹת. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXV, 9 (play on כמס, Deut. XXXII, 34) כמוס למאוסים reserved for the rejected (nations; differ. in Sifré Deut. 324). Der. Er. ch. II המ' בעיניהם those who are despised in their own eyes (think little of themselves); a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִמְאָס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be repulsive, loathsome; to be rejected</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. VIII (ref. to Lev. XXVI, 44) וכי … שלא נִמְאֲסוּ ושלא נגעלו what has been left to them so that (it might be said) they were not cast away and loathed?; Yalk. Lev. 675 (corr. acc.). Ḥag. 5
<sup>a</sup> ונ' and becomes 
<pgbrk id="pg724" />loathsome (creates aversion to his neighbor).—V. מִיאוּס.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="M00050">
<head-word>מְאַס</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. XXVI, 44; a. e.—V. מְאִיס.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְמָאַס</binyan-form>
